channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tex Winter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tex Winter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bob McAdoo on Tex Winter
item.description:
“I am grateful, honored and humbled to have been selected by the NBCA Selection Committee for the 2026 Tex Winter Assistant Coach Lifetime Impact Award,”

Bob McAdoo on Tex Winter, Jul 11, 2026. Source: NBA Coaches Association.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Tex Winter
item.description:
KC Johnson:Steve Kerr on the late Tex Winter:

“When we go to practice, when we watch film, I’m constantly thinking about Tex’s voice in my head. He taught me probably more about the game than anybody.”

Steve Kerr on Tex Winter, Oct 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Phil Jackson, Tex Winter
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Kobe Bryant on new ESPN show (2/2):

“I learned how to study film from the best coaches of all time – Phil Jackson and Tex Winter. Detail provides an opportunity to teach that skill to the next generation on large platform with ESPN.”

Kobe Bryant on Phil Jackson, Tex Winter, Jan 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Tex Winter
item.description:
“I’m a Tex Winter disciple, and in Chicago, I’ll never forget one of my first practices with Michael (Jordan) and Scottie (Pippen),”

Steve Kerr on Tex Winter, Sep 26, 2017. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Johnny Bach on Tex Winter
item.description:
What flows forth is a love letter of sorts, words for his friend Tex Winter about the sport they so cherish.

“I write Tex about how the Bulls are doing and what I see in the league or what I think about Miami, that kind of stuff,”

Johnny Bach on Tex Winter, Apr 4, 2011. Source: Chicago Tribune.
